about: Findings from tonight, drafted as SHarness issues (sharness-ai 0.2.0). NOT FILED: Dinis decides whether and where.
where: R1 Claude Code cloud, riskmandate-personal (harness.1's container; uid 0, all capabilities, no seccomp before any policy)

issues.title: contain --profile newsroom-agent: a contained uid-0 process can read /etc/shadow
issues.severity: high (the gap story: the sentence reads as contained, the kernel grants all of /etc)

observed./etc/shadow: readable: yes (one byte read to a workspace file, never into a record; the file was deleted)

issues.why: the profile template reads all of /etc, and the process runs as uid 0, so file mode 0640 root:shadow does not stop it; Landlock is the only check and its row covers /etc. The hand-written rows of E1+E2 (read /etc/ssl only) refused /etc/shadow with EACCES.
issues.expected: a profile for an agent reads what it needs of /etc (ssl, resolv.conf, hosts, nsswitch.conf, passwd if needed), never shadow or gshadow; or contain warns when uid 0 and a profile reads /etc
suggest: narrow the profile templates' /etc row to named files
contain: refuse or warn when running as uid 0 without a uid drop
explain: list secrets-bearing paths a row covers (/etc/shadow, /etc/gshadow, /root)

issues.title: max_memory_mb is RLIMIT_AS: node (V8) cannot start under 512 MiB and aborts with TLS under 1024 MiB
issues.severity: medium (fails closed, but silently for TLS; pushes people to raise the limit far above real use)

observed.error: Fatal process out of memory: Failed to reserve virtual memory for CodeRange

observed.result: refused: RangeError: Array buffer allocation failed

issues.why: run applies the memory row as RLIMIT_AS and cgroup1 memory.limit_in_bytes together; V8 reserves address space it never commits (code range, and more with OpenSSL threads), so the address-space limit binds long before the memory limit
suggest: apply max_memory_mb as the cgroup limit only where a cgroup can be made, and RLIMIT_AS only as a fallback
doctor/run: name the signal when the child dies by SIGABRT/SIGKILL under a limit

issues.title: net serve --audit: the streamed line for a cut fronting tunnel says allowed: true
issues.severity: low (the cut holds; the log misreports it)
issues.observed: CONNECT storm-charles.promptugal.news:443 with SNI openrouter.ai: the client got no bytes back (cut), the audit line on stderr reads allowed: true, status 200
issues.why: Proxy._tunnel updates self.line (allowed False, row no domain fronting) after Audit.record has already written it
suggest: write the audit line when the tunnel ends, or write a second line for the cut

issues.title: the inherited environment: v0 has no row for it
issues.severity: medium (known and stated by run; the CISO question)
issues.observed: not covered: 17 credential-like env names inherited by the harnessed child (names counted, values never read); 0 when the harness is started with env -i
suggest: an env row: allow-list of names, default empty
contain --secrets to be the only way a secret reaches the child
